associations.rationale: The dimension dichotomy is a consequence constraining possible irreducibles, but it does not identify their isomorphism classes exhaustively.
Counting one-dimensional representations for fields of size at least three is a classification aid and does not cover every irreducible or the q=2 case.
This proves irreducibility of the zero-sum subrepresentation, supplying one constituent of the classification without stating that all irreducibles are exhausted by the displayed families.
